headline: City rivals seek sanctions beyond relegation
summary: BBC Sport reports that several Premier League clubs want Manchester City's financial case to bring penalties covering both past seasons and the future. Ideas include deductions across multiple seasons, transfer restrictions and compensation for rivals. City have appealed against the independent commission's findings and maintain their innocence. These are proposals from rival clubs; the final punishment has yet to be decided.
